description.value: The study investigated PTSD- and trauma-related structural alterations in cortical regions using cortical parcellation and voxel-based morphometry in traumatized refugees with PTSD, traumatized controls and nontraumatized controls.

spans.text: The objective of the study was to investigate the effects of traumatization and PTSD on brain morphology.
